integrity: Self-review mathematical reconstruction and exact-arithmetic moment checks were performed. There was no independent review or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Results are for one-dimensional linear Ornstein–Uhlenbeck drift, independent Poisson times and a fixed positive contraction factor. Asymptotics are pointwise in parameters; no uniform weak-reset error or nonlinear extension is claimed. Historical priority is qualified by possible broader Gaussian-variance-mixture results.
title: Exact endpoint law and sharp Gaussian tails for partially reset Ornstein–Uhlenbeck diffusion
